title.en: Gold 3 v1 identity, classroom, and payment hardening
title.zh: Gold 3 v1 身份、课堂与付款加固

purpose.en: Make Clerk the canonical request identity, bind classroom authority to verified members, and complete SmartPay5 receipt and atomic course-renewal hardening.
purpose.zh: 将 Clerk 设为每次请求的规范身份，把课堂权限绑定到已验证会员，并完成 SmartPay5 收据及课程原子续期加固。

en: Extract the internal SmartPay5 TransactionID from the confirmed receipt event while retaining transaction-hash recovery.
Bound and rate-limit payment prepare and verify requests.
Calculate calendar-month course renewal from the latest committed access end inside the D1 write.
Authorize every request from the active Clerk primary identity and safely rekey compatible legacy member records.
Bind classroom cohost, invite, subscription, and stage-speaker grants only after a current verified Clerk session.
Use per-tab media capabilities so participants cannot impersonate or control another classroom device.
zh: 从已确认收据事件提取 SmartPay5 内部 TransactionID，同时保留交易哈希找回兼容。
限制付款准备与验证请求体大小并实施账户限流。
在 D1 写入内从最新已提交权益结束时间按日历月续期课程。
每次请求均以有效 Clerk 主身份授权，并安全重键兼容的旧会员记录。
课堂联合主持、邀请、订阅及上台发言权限仅在当前 Clerk 会话验证后绑定。
使用每标签页媒体能力令牌，防止参与者冒用或控制其他课堂设备。

en: Clerk-to-D1 identity synchronization, classroom access and media controls, crypto checkout reconciliation, payment APIs, and course package persistence.
zh: 影响 Clerk 与 D1 身份同步、课堂访问及媒体控制、加密付款对账、付款 API 与课程套餐持久化。

en: Stop treating an EVM transaction hash as the SmartPay5 internal payment identifier.
Serialize concurrent course extensions with a SQL CTE and preserve end-of-month calendar semantics.
Keep SmartPay payer and recipient identifiers immutable while atomically rekeying site-local identity references.
Keep existing classroom rows backward-compatible during migrate-before-deploy and require verified identity binding before they grant authority.
Resume a daily Sprint draft only when it belongs to the current local date for that learner.
Normalize generated SmartLingo wallet asset whitespace so the exact release passes the repository integrity gate.
Keep protected-page layout coverage after the Clerk-only identity cutover through a random per-run, loopback-only D1 fixture that cannot authorize production requests.
zh: 不再将 EVM 交易哈希误作 SmartPay5 内部付款标识。
使用 SQL CTE 串行化并发课程续期，并保留月底日历语义。
保持 SmartPay 付款人与收款人标识不可变，同时原子重键站点本地身份引用。
在先迁移后部署的窗口保持现有课堂记录向后兼容，并在授予权限前要求已验证身份绑定。
仅当每日 Sprint 草稿属于学习者当前本地日期时才恢复。
清理 SmartLingo 钱包生成资产的行尾空格，使精确发布通过仓库完整性闸门。
Clerk 单一身份切换后，使用每次随机、仅限本机回环地址的 D1 临时身份继续覆盖受保护页面布局，且该入口无法授权生产请求。

en: Run identity and classroom security suites, receipt-event behavior tests, calendar-boundary and concurrency tests, all tracked D1 migrations twice, the full test suite, TypeScript, lint, sensitive-data scan, and the verified production build before deployment.
zh: 部署前运行身份与课堂安全测试、收据事件行为测试、日历边界与并发测试、全部 D1 迁移双次执行、完整测试、TypeScript、静态检查、敏感信息扫描及已验证生产构建。

en: This portfolio rollout does not include a real-wallet payment or multiparty realtime browser acceptance; those remain explicit operator acceptance cases.
zh: 本轮多站发布不包含真实钱包付款或多人实时浏览器验收；这些仍由运营方按需专项验收。

en: Preserve the SmartLingo 12-language learning products, language-scoped course and price catalog, header, footer, referrals, certificates, Clerk, D1, R2, RealtimeKit, and independent infrastructure.
Use the SmartLingo-owned wallet connector namespace registered in the shared site manifest, without importing branding or runtime assets from another site.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 的 12 语种学习产品、按语言区分的课程与价格目录、页眉页脚、推荐、证书、Clerk、D1、R2、RealtimeKit 及独立基础设施。
使用共享站点清单中登记的 SmartLingo 自有钱包连接器命名空间，不导入其他站点的品牌或运行资产。

rollback.en: Roll back the Worker to the previous verified release if required. The additive identity and classroom columns, indexes, and compatibility triggers may remain; review any completed Clerk user-ID rekeys before attempting manual data reversal, and never rewrite immutable SmartPay payerId or refId history.
rollback.zh: 如需回退，可将 Worker 回退到上一已验证版本。新增的身份与课堂字段、索引及兼容触发器可以保留；如已有 Clerk 用户 ID 重键，手工回退数据前须逐项审核，并绝不改写不可变的 SmartPay payerId 或 refId 历史。
